## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # IVector styling
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Paint and fill styling
//  - Stroke styling

//==
// # Paint and fill styling
//
// What a region is filled with: gradients, texture paints, the paint sum that
// selects among them, the fill description, drop shadows, and the styled-path
// pairing of geometry with appearance. Consumes Path2D from `paths.types.plato`,
// Color/ColorGradient from `color.types.plato`, and Texture2D from `texturing.types.plato`;
// the stroke side follows in the next section.

// How a gradient continues beyond its defining geometry: clamp to the end
// colors (Pad), mirror-repeat (Reflect), or tile (Repeat).
type GradientSpread = Pad | Reflect | Repeat;

// A gradient that varies linearly from Start to End, constant along lines
// perpendicular to the segment joining them.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Color_gradient)
type LinearGradient2D
    implements IValue
{
    Start: Point2D;
    End: Point2D;
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Spread: GradientSpread;
}

// A gradient that varies radially between a focal circle (Focus, FocusRadius)
// and an outer circle (Center, Radius), in the two-circle Canvas/Skia form.
// Focus equal to Center with FocusRadius zero gives the common single-circle
// case.
type RadialGradient2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
    Focus: Point2D;
    FocusRadius: Number;
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Spread: GradientSpread;
}

// A gradient that varies with angle around Center, starting at StartAngle and
// sweeping one full turn counter-clockwise.
type SweepGradient2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    StartAngle: Angle;
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Spread: GradientSpread;
}

// A paint sourced from a texture (`texturing.types.plato`), positioned by an affine transform
// from texture space into the space of the geometry being filled.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_mapping)
type TexturePaint2D
    implements IValue
{
    Texture: Texture2D;
    Transform: AffineTransform2D;
}

// The paint source a region is filled with: a single flat color, one of three
// gradient kinds, or a texture. Exactly one source applies per paint.
type Paint
    implements IValue
    = Solid(Color: Color)                  // a single flat color
    | Linear(Gradient: LinearGradient2D)   // linear (axial) gradient
    | Radial(Gradient: RadialGradient2D)   // radial (two-circle) gradient
    | Sweep(Gradient: SweepGradient2D)     // angular sweep gradient
    | Texture(Paint: TexturePaint2D);      // a texture paint

// The complete description of how a region is painted: the paint source, and
// an Opacity that multiplies the chosen paint's alpha.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha_compositing)
type FillStyle
    implements IValue
{
    Paint: Paint;
    Opacity: Proportion;
}

// A shadow cast by filled geometry: offset in the geometry's space, Gaussian
// blur radius, spread (outset applied before blurring; negative insets), and
// color including alpha. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drop_shadow)
type ShadowStyle2D
    implements IValue
{
    Offset: Vector2D;
    BlurRadius: Number;
    Spread: Number;
    Color: Color;
}

// A path paired with its appearance: fill first, then stroke on top. The
// canonical drawable unit of 2D vector graphics (see Scene2D in `scene2d.types.plato`).
type StyledPath2D
    implements IValue
{
    Path: Path2D;
    Fill: FillStyle;
    Stroke: StrokeStyle;
}

//==
// # Stroke styling
//
// The geometry side of painting a path: caps, joins, alignment, dash
// patterns, the complete stroke description, the markers stamped along a
// stroked path, and the parameter records for turning a stroke or a dash into
// concrete path geometry. Consumes Path2D from `paths.types.plato`; the paint side
// is the section above.

// The shape a stroke takes at the open end of a contour: flat at the
// endpoint (Butt), a semicircular cap (Round), or flat but extended past the
// endpoint by half the stroke width (Square).
type LineCap = Butt | Round | Square;

// The shape a stroke takes where two segments meet at a corner. Miter is
// sharp, subject to the miter limit.
type LineJoin = Miter | Round | Bevel;

// Where the stroke width sits relative to the path centerline: half each
// side (Center), toward the fill (Inside), or away from it (Outside).
type StrokeAlign = Center | Inside | Outside;

// An on/off dash sequence applied along a stroked contour's arc length.
// Intervals alternate drawn and skipped lengths, starting with drawn, and
// repeat; an empty array means a solid stroke. Phase shifts the pattern's
// starting point along the contour, in the same units.
type DashPattern
    implements IValue
{
    Intervals: Array<Number>;
    Phase: Number;
}

// The complete geometric description of how a path is stroked. Width is the
// total stroke width. MiterLimit caps a miter join's reach as a multiple of
// half the stroke width, as in SVG; joins beyond it fall back to bevel.
type StrokeStyle
    implements IValue
{
    Width: Number;
    Cap: LineCap;
    Join: LineJoin;
    MiterLimit: Number;
    Dash: DashPattern;
    Align: StrokeAlign;
}
```
